correctness.rationale: An exact binomial log-weight filter gives the iterated moments. If they are polynomial, holomorphic germ identity near infinity implies an exact logarithmic-derivative identity. Root-orbit multiplicities obey integer convolution, whose first-moment identity forces rational lambda. The coprime endpoint filter forces multiplicities divisible by v^k; integer positivity excludes even-denominator sign-changing roots. Conversely a positive v^k-th-root polynomial yields an explicit positive polynomial moment of the unchanged degree and hence strict (degree+1)-isometry. Boundedness follows from weights converging to one. Exact checker returned 191 supplementary assertions; infinite proof is analytic, not based on enumeration.

value.rationale: A complete exact classification of a natural all-order scalar weighted-shift family answers the generalized m-isometry preservation question for these shifts: rational versus irrational parameter transition, v^k-th power root arithmetic, necessary positive integer-root sign, sharp finite survival depth and strict-order divisibility. It distinguishes known 2-isometry failure from nontrivial simultaneous 3-isometry examples and provides exact examples and reusable criteria, not an arbitrary isolated computation.
